# Healthcare Informatics

Selected work from MBA 673 — Healthcare Information Systems, focused on using clinical data, SQL, R, visualization, and healthcare information systems to support better decisions.

## Analysis Reports

### [Analysis Report One — What's Your Data Strategy](analysis-report-01/index.qmd)

Examines the balance between defensive and offensive data strategy in healthcare, using nutrition-related clinical data to explore early risk identification, data quality, and transitions of care.
